claims.statement: EUDR applies from 30 December 2026 to large and medium enterprises and from 30 June 2027 to most micro and small enterprises; operators must complete due diligence and submit statements when risk is negligible.
The Commission updated product scope and the Information System in July 2026, so workflows must track current rules rather than frozen checklists.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: Importer compliance, procurement or supply-chain lead
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: Supplier chase, geolocation QA and Polish-language exception handling; trade-compliance suites can bundle
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business under direct importer subscriptions
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Customs brokers, commodity accountants, ERP consultants and outbound

fully_loaded_economics.cash_conversion: Implementation upfront; subscription monthly or annual prepaid
fully_loaded_economics.contribution_margin: Assumption: 60-75% after specialist review and data services
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Supplier onboarding, geospatial validation and exception support
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Security, legal updates, professional liability and audit logs
fully_loaded_economics.revenue_basis: Subscription by supplier/commodity volume plus onboarding
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Geospatial APIs, translation, support and specialist review

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: ERP and customs platforms add EUDR modules; consultants offer manual compliance
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: Due-diligence evidence and statement required before an in-scope commodity is placed on or exported from the EU market
commercial_mechanics.payer: First operator placing covered goods on the EU market
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: EUDR application date, new supplier or failed evidence check
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Annual subscription and each new shipment/supplier evidence cycle

contrary_evidence: 2025 simplifications reduced downstream obligations and data load.
Commodity traders may consolidate around global platforms.

critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Serve a different commodity chain or provide one-off supplier-readiness audits
critical_control_point.current_owner: Importers and upstream suppliers own documents and geolocation data; the Commission controls submission infrastructure
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: unknown today; proposed future ownership by the prospective business under direct importer subscriptions
critical_control_point.launch_controller: Prospective business after signed importer authorization and supplier participation
critical_control_point.subject: Supplier evidence and geolocation workflow feeding EUDR due diligence

economics.acquisition_route: Start with paid evidence-gap audits for one commodity, then productize recurring supplier intake and geolocation checks
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 400 customers at 24,000 PLN ARR and 25% EBITDA could create 2.4m PLN EBITDA; 4-6x valuation supports 5m+ founder value in years 6-9. Customer count and churn are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 20 hours weekly for product and sales; compliance specialists handle edge cases
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription less geospatial, support and expert-review costs
economics.payback: Assumption: 8-12 customers recover product cost inside 18 months
economics.pricing: Assumption: 10,000-30,000 PLN onboarding and 1,000-5,000 PLN monthly
economics.retention_or_repeat: Ongoing shipment, supplier and rule changes

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Supplier-resolution graph and recurring evidence-quality benchmarks
fingerprint.customer: CEE importers of wood, coffee, cocoa, rubber and other covered goods
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Managed evidence gateway sold by subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: First operator pays when covered trade requires defensible due diligence
fingerprint.problem_trigger: EUDR deadlines meet missing upstream geolocation and legality evidence

founder_fit: Document AI and anomaly detection fit.

structural_signature.control_point_descriptor: resolved supplier and geolocation evidence graph

structure.critical_dependency: Truthful upstream geolocation and legality data

thesis: Future state: covered imports clear EUDR checks through traceable supplier evidence. The missing data-coordination mechanism is a gateway that chases, validates, versions and transmits geolocation and legality evidence.
title: EUDR Supplier-Evidence Gateway
